metadata.coordinateConvention: x east, y north; renderer z=-y

terrain.method: GEDTM30 v1.2 bare-earth estimates, bilinear projected display interpolation; ocean at 0 m, mapped standing water at local median; rivers follow terrain.
terrain.buildingGroundMethod: Median terrain samples within each footprint, plus representative-point interpolation. Estimated ground anchor, not a surveyed entrance or floor elevation.
